content: In this section, we describe methods to explore combinatorially sized action spaces such as text-games—focusing especially on methods that can deal with their inherent bottleneck structure. We first describe our method that explicitly attempts to detect bottlenecks and then describe how an exploration algorithm such as Go Explore BIBREF9 can leverage knowledge graphs.
